CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments the Director Board under Road Development Authority, Statute No. 2 of 2003

I, Ediriweera Weerawardhana, Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy, Housing and Construction, ofthe Central Provincial Council give notice that under the powers vested in me by Statute 2 of the Road DevelopmentAuthority Act, No. 2 of 2003 Central Provincial Council, appoint the under mentioned officers as members of the DirectorBoard of the above authority from the dates given in front of their names.
EDIRIWEERA WEERAWARDHANA,Minister of Road Development,Transport, Power and Energy,Housing and Construction,Central Province.
